rules.statement: Among co-heirs the very strongest evidence of adverse possession should be given. In my judgment, such evidence can very rarely prove division unless it comes in the form of notarial conveyances, either cross between the heirs or so specifying the shares they severally deal with at different times as to indicate their acquiescence and possession on that basis.
